title: Imam e zamana ka ashiq bana de
body:
Imam e zamana ka ashiq bana de
Khudaya mukadar mera yun jagade
<<DIVIDER>>
Imame zamana ka aashik banade
Meri maa ki koshish ka usko sila de
<<DIVIDER>>
Imame zamana ka aaashiq banade
1. Karun zikr zehra ka tahir banun me
<<DIVIDER>>
imaame zamana ka nasir banun me
meri maa ki koshish ka usko sila de
<<DIVIDER>>
imame zamana ka aashiq banade
2. Har ek dilko azme hussaini aata ho
<<DIVIDER>>
har ek jaa ko jooshe khuaini aata ho
gutan ki fazao me taza hawa de
<<DIVIDER>>
imame zamana ka aashiq banade
3. Zamane ki chaalo se ghabra gaya hun
<<DIVIDER>>
gunaaho ki duniya se tang aagaya hun
gunaaho ki zindaa se mujhko chuda de
<<DIVIDER>>
imame zamana ka aashiq banade
4. Aata kar jawano ko akber ki himmat
<<DIVIDER>>
mille mere bacho ko asger ki himmat
khudaya unhe muskurana sikhade
<<DIVIDER>>
imame zamana ka aashiq banade
5. Meri maa ki khwahish fidaye hussaini
<<DIVIDER>>
he ghutti me meri aazaye hussaini
aaza par me jaa dun mujhe hausla de
<<DIVIDER>>
imame zamana ka aashiq banade
6. Amal se hi apni gawahi likhun me
<<DIVIDER>>
imame zamaa ka sipahi banun me
shahadat k raste pe chalna sikhade
<<DIVIDER>>
imame zamana ka aashiq banade
7. Ho akhlaaq pyaara to meethi zaba hoon
<<DIVIDER>>
kamar do jahano me yun shadmaan ho
dua dun me jisko mujhe wo dua de
<<DIVIDER>>
imame zamana ka aashiq banade
author: Shadman Raza
